## Authentication

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /_next/static/{staticToken}/{staticToken}` — Retrieve static assets for authentication flow.

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /api/v1/{v1Id}` — Retrieve data using a version 1 ID.
- `GET /api/v1/projects/{projectHash}` — Retrieve details for a specific project.
- `GET /api/v1/users/me` — Get the currently authenticated user's profile.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /{id}/` — Update data associated with a specific ID.
- `POST /i/v0/e/` — Post event data to the system.

### Core API (1)
- `POST /api/{apiId}` — Access core Autosend API functionality.

```typescript
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Autosend's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Autosend data without official API access
- Automate actions on autosend.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Autosend frontend uses

```typescript

    // Auth expired — need to re-capture

}
```
